variables.query:

WHERE pp_code ='BU2'

SELECT
    -- 1. Metadata & Identification
    EPS_CODE AS "EPS",
    IP_CODE AS "IPCODE",
    EPS_DESC AS "EPS DESCRIPTION",
    "Machine" AS "TM",
    "Inspection Date" AS "TEST DATE",
    Barcode AS "BARCODE",
    "Final Class" AS "CLASS",
    
    -- 2. Process Dates & Machines
    "CU Date" AS "VULC DATE",
    "CU Mch" AS "MCH VULC",
    "Mould_NO" AS "MCH MOULD",
    MAT_CODE AS "SPEC CODE",
    "BU MCH" AS "MCH BUILD",
    WM_CODE,
    "BU Date" AS "BUILD DATE",
    CRUDI AS "TYRE TYPE",
    
    -- 3. Uniformity & Geometry Metrics (Existing Only)
    RFV, 
    RFV_GR, 
    H1RFV, 
    H1RFV_GR, 
    H2RFV, 
    H2RFV_GR, 
    LFV, 
    LFV_GR, 
    CONICITY, 
    CONICITY_GR, 
    RRO, 
    RRO_GR, 
    LRO, 
    LRO_GR, 
    BULGES, 
    BULGES_GR, 
    UNB_DY_LO, 
    UNB_DY_LO_GR, 
    UNB_DY_UP, 
    UNB_DY_UP_GR,

    -- 4. Extra Columns (Moved to end)
    TEST_ID,
    "CU Side"
FROM (
    SELECT 
        U.TEST_ID, U.EPS_CODE, U.IP_CODE, U.EPS_DESC,
        U.MM_TM_Testing_code AS "Machine",
        U.Data_ora AS "Inspection Date",
        U.Barcode,
        B.TRC_TIMESTAMP AS "BU Date",
        B.MCH_CODE AS "BU MCH",
        B.WM_CODE,
        C.TRC_TIMESTAMP AS "CU Date",
        C.MCH_CODE AS "CU Mch",
        C.TRC_SIDE AS "CU Side", 
        MLD.MTO_TOOL_CODE_1 AS "Mould_NO",
        U.GR_MISURA AS "Final Class",
        U.CONICITY, U.CONICITY_GR, U.H1RFV, U.H1RFV_GR,
        U.H2RFV, U.H2RFV_GR, U.LFV, U.LFV_GR, U.RFV,
        U.RFV_GR, U.RRO, U.RRO_GR, U.UNB_DY_LO,
        U.UNB_DY_LO_GR, U.UNB_DY_UP, U.UNB_DY_UP_GR,
        U.LRO, U.BULGES, U.BULGES_GR, U.LRO_GR,
        M.MAT_CODE,
        V.CRUDI,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY U.Barcode ORDER BY U.Data_ora DESC) AS rn

    FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FIN_MUL38"."MM_RESULTS" U

    -- Building Join
    LEFT JOIN "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_PCS02"."TRC_BASIC_TABLE_WITH_HIS" B
        ON B.TRC_BARCODE = U.Barcode
        AND B.PP_CODE = 'BU2'

    -- Curing Join
    LEFT JOIN "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_PCS02"."TRC_BASIC_TABLE_WITH_HIS" C
        ON C.TRC_BARCODE = U.Barcode
        AND C.PP_CODE = 'CU1'
    
    -- Mould Join
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            MCH_CODE, MCN_SIDE, MTO_TOOL_CODE_1, MTO_START_DATE, 
            COALESCE(MTO_END_DATE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) AS end_date
        FROM EG_CA_TRU_FAC_PCS02.SCH_MACHINE_TOOL_WITH_HIS
        WHERE PP_CODE = 'CU1'
    ) AS MLD
        ON C.MCH_CODE = MLD.MCH_CODE 
        AND C.TRC_SIDE = MLD.MCN_SIDE 
        AND (C.TRC_TIMESTAMP BETWEEN MLD.MTO_START_DATE AND MLD.end_date)

    -- Material Data
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT * FROM (
            SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MAT_IP_CODE ORDER BY MAT_IMPORT_TIMESTAMP DESC) AS rn
            FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_PCS02"."MD_MATERIALS"
        ) M1 WHERE rn = 1
    ) M ON M.MAT_IP_CODE = U.IP_CODE

    -- Crudi / BOM Calculation
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            BOM.MAT_SAP_CODE AS SAW,
            A_VAL.MD_PPA_VALUE AS CRUDI
        FROM EG_CA_TRU_FAC_PCS02.MD_BOM BOM
        INNER JOIN EG_CA_TRU_FAC_PCS02.MD_BOM CHILD_BOM
            ON CHILD_BOM.MAT_SAP_CODE = BOM.CHILD_MAT_SAP_CODE
            AND CHILD_BOM.CNT_CODE = BOM.CHILD_CNT_CODE
            AND CHILD_BOM.BV_STATUS = 'P'
        INNER JOIN EG_CA_TRU_FAC_PCS02.MD_PROCESS_PARAMETERS_ACYCLE_VALUE A_VAL
            ON A_VAL.MAT_SAP_CODE = CHILD_BOM.MAT_SAP_CODE
            AND A_VAL.CNT_CODE = CHILD_BOM.CNT_CODE
            AND A_VAL.MT_CODE = CHILD_BOM.MT_CODE
            AND A_VAL.ST_CODE = '001'
    ) V ON M.MAT_SAP_CODE = V.SAW

    WHERE $__timeFilter(U.Data_ora)
) t
WHERE rn = 1;

SELECT 
    SUBSTRING(EPS_CODE, 2, 3) AS "Short Code",
    CASE 
        WHEN MM_TM_Testing_code = '00' THEN 'Hoffman'
        WHEN MM_TM_Testing_code = '01' THEN 'D9O'
        WHEN MM_TM_Testing_code = '02' THEN 'ZF'
    END AS "Machine",
    
    -- Counts
    SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Class A",
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "Class A %",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Class B",
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "Class B %",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Class C",
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "Class C %",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Class E",
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "Class E %"

    -- Percentages
    -- We calculate (Class / Total) * 100

FROM (
    SELECT 
        MM_TM_Testing_code,
        EPS_CODE,
        GR_MISURA AS Final_Class,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Barcode ORDER BY Data_ora DESC) AS rn
    FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FIN_MUL38"."MM_RESULTS"
    WHERE $__timeFilter(Data_ora)
    AND Barcode LIKE '811%'
) t
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY SUBSTRING(EPS_CODE, 2, 3), MM_TM_Testing_code;

SELECT 
    MCH_CODE AS "Building_Mch",
    -- Class A
    SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Class A",
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "Class A %",
    
    -- Class B
    SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Class B",
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "Class B %",
    
    -- Class C
    SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Class C",
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "Class C %",
    
    -- Class E
    SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Class E",
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "Class E %",
        
    COUNT(*) AS "Total_Tires"

FROM (
    SELECT 
        U.MM_TM_Testing_code,
        U.EPS_CODE,
        U.GR_MISURA AS Final_Class,
        T.MCH_CODE,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY U.Barcode ORDER BY U.Data_ora DESC) AS rn
    FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FIN_MUL38"."MM_RESULTS" U 
    LEFT JOIN "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_PCS02"."TRC_BASIC_TABLE" T
        ON U.Barcode = T.TRC_BARCODE 
        AND T.PP_CODE = 'BU2'    
    WHERE $__timeFilter(U.Data_ora)
      AND U.Barcode LIKE '811%'
) FF
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY MCH_CODE
ORDER BY MCH_CODE ASC;

SELECT 
    MCH_CODE,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Class_A,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Class_B,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Class_C,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Class_E
FROM (
    SELECT 
        MM_TM_Testing_code,
        EPS_CODE,
        GR_MISURA AS Final_Class,
        T.MCH_CODE,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Barcode ORDER BY Data_ora DESC) AS rn
    FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FIN_MUL38"."MM_RESULTS" U 
    LEFT JOIN "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_PCS02"."TRC_BASIC_TABLE" T
        ON U.Barcode = T.TRC_BARCODE 
       AND T.PP_CODE = 'BU2'    
    WHERE $__timeFilter(Data_ora)
      AND Barcode LIKE '811%'
) FF
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY MCH_CODE;

SELECT 
    MCH_CODE AS "BU MCH",
    "OP Name",
    WM_PHONE_PREFIX as "OP BU Num",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Class A",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Class B",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Class C",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Class E"
    
FROM 
(


SELECT 
        MM_TM_Testing_code,
        EPS_CODE,
        GR_MISURA AS Final_Class,
        T.MCH_CODE,
        CONCAT(W.WM_NAME,' ', w.WM_SURNAME) AS "op Name",
        w.WM_PHONE_PREFIX,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Barcode ORDER BY Data_ora DESC) AS rn
    FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FIN_MUL38"."MM_RESULTS" U 
    LEFT JOIN "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_PCS02"."TRC_BASIC_TABLE" T
ON (U.Barcode=T.TRC_BARCODE OR U.Barcode=T.TRC_ID ) AND T.PP_CODE = 'BU2'  
LEFT JOIN "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_CMS39"."MD_WORKERS" W
ON T.WM_CODE = W.WM_CODE
    WHERE $__timeFilter(Data_ora)
     AND Barcode like '811%'
     
) FF
where rn=1 and "BU MCH" in ($MCH)
GROUP BY MCH_CODE,"op Name","OP BU Num"

SELECT 
    SUBSTRING(EPS_CODE, 2, 3) AS "Short Code",

    SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class   = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Class E",
    SUM(CASE WHEN CONICITY_GR   = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "CONICITY_GR",
    SUM(CASE WHEN H1RFV_GR      = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "H1RFV_GR",
    SUM(CASE WHEN H2RFV_GR      = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "H2RFV_GR",
    SUM(CASE WHEN LFV_GR        = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "LFV_GR",
    SUM(CASE WHEN RFV_GR        = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "RFV_GR",
    SUM(CASE WHEN UNB_DY_LO_GR  = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "UNB_DY_LO_GR",
    SUM(CASE WHEN UNB_DY_UP_GR  = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "UNB_DY_UP_GR",
    SUM(CASE WHEN RRO_GR        = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "RRO_GR",
    SUM(CASE WHEN BULGES_GR     = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS  "BULGES_GR", 
    SUM(CASE WHEN LRO_GR        = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "LRO_GR"

FROM (
    SELECT 
        MM_TM_Testing_code,
        EPS_CODE,
        GR_MISURA AS Final_Class,
        CONICITY_GR,
        H1RFV_GR,
        H2RFV_GR,
        LFV_GR,
        RFV_GR,
        UNB_DY_LO_GR,
        UNB_DY_UP_GR,
        RRO_GR,
        BULGES_GR,
        LRO_GR,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Barcode ORDER BY Data_ora DESC) AS rn
    FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FIN_MUL38"."MM_RESULTS"
    WHERE $__timeFilter(Data_ora)
      AND Barcode LIKE '811%'
) t
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY 
    SUBSTRING(EPS_CODE, 2, 3),
    MM_TM_Testing_code
having "Class E" > 0

select  "Short_Code" ,round((Class_A*1.0 / total*1.0 ) *100,2) as OEE 
from (
SELECT 
    SUBSTRING(EPS_CODE, 2, 3) AS "Short_Code",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Final_Class = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Class_A,
    count(Barcode) as total
FROM (
    SELECT 
        EPS_CODE,
        GR_MISURA AS Final_Class,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Barcode ORDER BY Data_ora DESC) AS rn,
        Barcode
    FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FIN_MUL38"."MM_RESULTS"
    WHERE $__timeFilter(Data_ora)
   and Barcode like '811%'

) t
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY SUBSTRING(EPS_CODE, 2, 3))

SELECT
    t."Short_Code",
    ROUND(
        c.c_barcode_count * 1.0
        / t.total_barcode_count * 100.0,
        2
    ) AS "OEE"
FROM
(
    -- total DISTINCT barcodes per Short_Code
    SELECT
        SUBSTRING(EPS_CODE, 2, 3) AS "Short_Code",
        COUNT(DISTINCT Barcode) AS total_barcode_count
    FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FIN_MUL38"."MM_RESULTS"
    WHERE $__timeFilter(Data_ora)
      AND Barcode LIKE '811%'
    GROUP BY SUBSTRING(EPS_CODE, 2, 3)
) t
JOIN
(
    -- DISTINCT barcodes that have at least one Class = 'C'
    SELECT
        SUBSTRING(EPS_CODE, 2, 3) AS "Short_Code",
        COUNT(DISTINCT Barcode) AS c_barcode_count
    FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FIN_MUL38"."MM_RESULTS"
    WHERE $__timeFilter(Data_ora)
      AND Barcode LIKE '811%'
      AND Barcode IN (
          SELECT Barcode
          FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FIN_MUL38"."MM_RESULTS"
          WHERE GR_MISURA = 'C'
      )
    GROUP BY SUBSTRING(EPS_CODE, 2, 3)
) c
ON t."Short_Code" = c."Short_Code";

SELECT GR_MISURA, COUNT(Barcode) AS total
FROM (
    SELECT *, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Barcode ORDER BY Data_ora DESC) AS rn
    FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FIN_MUL38"."MM_RESULT_ALL_VIEW"
) AS last
WHERE $__timeFilter(Data_ora)
AND rn = 1
GROUP BY GR_MISURA
